# Publication, versions and history

Publishing snapshots the draft into a live version. History records every committed batch with its inverse, so `history.undo` reverses a batch. Provider operations (domains, publication effects) leave an external request that `external.status` / `external.close` inspect.

[`history.read`](#historyread) · [`history.undo`](#historyundo) · [`publication.publish`](#publicationpublish) · [`publication.activate`](#publicationactivate) · [`publication.rollbackPage`](#publicationrollbackpage) · [`external.status`](#externalstatus) · [`external.close`](#externalclose)

## history.read

Read the authoritative outcome of a committed request after rechecking its original permissions.

- permission `site.read` (admin, editor); class `read`; writes nothing.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `requestId` | uuid | yes |

Output: { requestId: uuid, revision: integer ≥0, dryRun: boolean, changed: boolean, revisions: Record<string, integer ≥0>, results: ({ name: string, ref?: string, output: string \| number \| boolean \| null \| (… \| … \| … \| … \| … \| …)[] \| Record<string, … \| … \| … \| … \| … \| …> })[], inverse: ({ name: string, input: string \| number \|… (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{"requestId":"0b7c6d5e-4f3a-4b2c-8d1e-9f0a1b2c3d4e"}
```

## history.undo

Reverse a committed batch after checking its documents and original permissions.

- permission `history.operation` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `history:{requestId}`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `requestId` | uuid | yes |

Output: { restored: uuid }

Example input:

```json
{"requestId":"0b7c6d5e-4f3a-4b2c-8d1e-9f0a1b2c3d4e"}
```

> Undo is refused with 409 when a later batch changed the same documents; undo the later one first, or rebuild the change by hand.

## publication.publish

Publish the site: snapshot the draft (pages whose status is published, their trees, menus, collections with their published items, design system, settings, fonts) into a new live version, so the public site serves it. Run it alone in a batch with `confirmed: ["publish"]` and the site_context baseRevisions (history included); it cannot be dry-run. External effects (cache purge, screenshots) run after the commit.

- permission `content.publish` (admin, editor, workspace owner); class `external`; writes `publication`, `pages`, `designSystem`, `settings`, `environment`, `apiConfig`, `fonts`, `brand`, `navigation`, `collections`; needs `"confirmed": ["publish"]`; **not undoable**: alone in its batch; external: alone in its batch, never in a dry run.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `note` | string (max 2000) |  |

Output: { version: { id: uuid, hash: string, timestamp: string, status: "building" \| "ready" \| "failed", isActive: boolean, note?: string, hasScreenshot?: boolean, hasMultipleScreenshots?: boolean } }

Example input:

```json
{"note":"Opening section and team page"}
```

> Publish only on the human's explicit go in the conversation. Alone in its batch, with `history` in `baseRevisions` (from a fresh `site_context`) and `"confirmed": ["publish"]`. The answer's `version.id` is the version to roll back to later.

## publication.activate

Make an earlier published version of the site live again (roll back). Run it alone in a batch with `confirmed: ["publish"]`. External effects (cache purge, screenshots) run after the commit.

- permission `versions.activate` (admin, workspace owner); class `external`; writes `publication`, `pages`, `designSystem`, `settings`, `environment`, `apiConfig`, `fonts`, `brand`, `navigation`, `collections`; needs `"confirmed": ["publish"]`; **not undoable**: alone in its batch; external: alone in its batch, never in a dry run.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `versionId` | uuid | yes |

Output: { success: true, versionId: uuid }

Example input:

```json
{"versionId":"8b9c0d1e-2f3a-4b4c-8d5e-6f7a8b9c0d1e"}
```

> Needs `versions.activate`: a platform admin, or the workspace owner of the site's workspace. Needs a version id: from a publish answer, or from `item.history` on a collection item; the admin's Publish & versions page shows no ids (its Make live button does the same). It replaces the draft as well: unpublished changes are lost.

## publication.rollbackPage

Restore one page of the draft to how an earlier published version held it: its page fields, its tree and its scenes, through the tree commit, so an open editor replays it. A page the draft no longer has is recreated at the same slug and parent path. The rest of the site is unchanged; publish to serve it. Run it alone in a batch with `confirmed: ["destructive"]`. `pageId` is the version's page, so the batch locks `pages` only; to guard the draft tree it rewrites, also pass `tree:<draft page id>` in baseRevisions, and a stale one is refused with 409 stale_revision.

- permission `site.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `pages`; needs `"confirmed": ["destructive"]`; **not undoable**: alone in its batch.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `pageId` | string (min 1) | yes |
| `versionId` | uuid | yes |

Output: { pageId: string (min 1), treeRevision: integer ≥0, recreated: boolean }

Example input:

```json
{"pageId":"6f1d2c3b-4a59-4e8d-9c7b-1a2b3c4d5e6f","versionId":"8b9c0d1e-2f3a-4b4c-8d5e-6f7a8b9c0d1e"}
```

> Restores one page of the draft from a version; publish afterwards (with the human's go) to serve it.

## external.status

Inspect a durable provider request without retrying its side effects.

- permission `site.admin` (admin); class `read`; writes nothing.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `requestId` | uuid | yes |

Output: { requestId: uuid, state: "running" \| "succeeded" \| "failed", errorStatus: integer ≥-9007199254740991 \| null }

Example input:

```json
{"requestId":"0b7c6d5e-4f3a-4b2c-8d1e-9f0a1b2c3d4e"}
```

## external.close

Close an interrupted provider reservation after inspecting domain state. Cannot close a live request; never repeats provider actions.

- permission `site.admin` (admin); class `transaction`; writes `site`; needs `"confirmed": ["destructive"]`; **not undoable**: alone in its batch.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `requestId` | uuid | yes |

Output: { requestId: uuid, state: "running" \| "succeeded" \| "failed", errorStatus: integer ≥-9007199254740991 \| null }

Example input:

```json
{"requestId":"0b7c6d5e-4f3a-4b2c-8d1e-9f0a1b2c3d4e"}
```
